what: P1's final window was read with no qualifying candidate
root_cause: Pre-registration said run it "for the record"
correction: — (P1 frozen)
prevention: ORB B9: the final window is read only if a configuration qualifies; enforced in `research/orb/study.py` (test)

what: "Paper trading is live" was claimed when nothing ran continuously
root_cause: Configuration confused with operation
correction: STATUS.md separates configured, verified and running

what: Broker allow-list matched by prefix, so `/v2/account/configurations` would have passed
root_cause: Prefix match
correction: Exact (host, path) pairs

what: "Refuse a second final run" was presented as overfitting protection
root_cause: Confused re-execution with re-selection
correction: Freeze by hash; reproduce-only re-runs; consumed-data ledger

what: One request to sec.gov carried the owner's email address in its User-Agent header
root_cause: SEC asks for a contact in the User-Agent; I used the owner's address without asking
correction: Stopped; later requests use a non-personal identifier
prevention: Personal data is never sent to an outside service without the owner's say-so; the SEC contact is the owner's choice

what: The detached ORB development run died partway through with URLError: Connection refused
root_cause: http_get retried 429 and 5xx responses but let transport exceptions escape
correction: Transport errors become a retryable 599 (8 retries, backoff capped at 60 s); the runner restarts itself up to 10 times and resumes from the cache

what: The container restarted while the session was idle (~04:10 and again ~04:35 UTC) and killed the detached ORB run and prefetch
root_cause: The session's container is reclaimed when no turn or tracked task is active; processes detached with setsid/nohup are untracked and do not keep it alive
correction: Long jobs run as session-tracked background tasks (2 h limit each, re-launched on exit); everything is cached on disk, so a restart only loses time
prevention: 20-minute check-ins relaunch tracked tasks if absent

what: GitHub Actions ran the 15-minute crypto schedule only at 03:52 and 04:25 (2 of about 5 slots)
root_cause: GitHub's free scheduler delays and drops cron runs under load
correction: None possible within Actions; the runner catches up on every missed bar, so no data is lost, but decisions run 30+ minutes late
prevention: Watchdog alerts if no success in 2 h. Real intraday trading needs an always-on host, not Actions

what: The ORB 2021 prefetch crashed: NaTType does not support strftime
root_cause: The in-play basket benchmark recorded a trade even when it never filled (a selected stock with no bar after 09:35); the quote lookup then hit the missing entry time
correction: Unfilled basket trades are skipped and counted as basket_no_fill; no fill is invented
verified: Caught in development, before any result was produced

what: The ORB direction-only benchmark (+81 bp gross, +60 bp net per trade in development) was a look-ahead artifact. It produced an 'exploratory lead', the H3 pre-registration, and statements in the morning report
root_cause: run_period recorded direction-only only after the breakout stop order had triggered, so stock-days that never reached the opening-range level after 09:35 (the losers, -379 bp) were dropped. ORB B5.4 defines direction-only without the trigger. The direction-lead audit checked concentration and years but not how the sample was selected
correction: direction-only is recorded at 09:35 for every non-doji stock-day the configuration may trade; development frames regenerated; H3 Amendment 1 gates validation on the corrected development check; reports corrected
prevention: test_direction_benchmark_does_not_depend_on_a_later_breakout (fails without the fix); rule: every benchmark or candidate is checked for conditioning on information after its decision time before it is reported as a lead
verified: Found by reading the harness before the H3 validation fetch finished; the fetch was stopped before any 2022-23 outcome was computed or read

what: The phase-2 daily panel build was killed by the out-of-memory killer (6.8 GB) after downloading 2016-2021
root_cause: build_panel accumulated every bar of every year as Python tuples before pivoting (~28M tuples)
correction: Download and assembly separated; assembly streams year by year into float32 frames and keeps only the fields each panel needs (all: OHLCV; raw: close, volume)
prevention: Panels are built per year; a long download never holds bars in memory. Cached requests made the restart lossless
verified: Restarted from cache; no request repeated
